naive_architecture.summary: Driver opens app, scans QR on charger, app authenticates with cloud, cloud unlocks charger, billing per kWh, payment via Stripe.
naive_architecture.business_context: Pan-European EV charging network. Win the moment the driver pulls in. Time-to-unlock is the metric.
assumptions: Driver has a smartphone with our app installed
QR sticker is intact and scannable
No regulator changes the billing dimension
Our cloud is reachable from the charger
The cable physically engages and disengages on command

user_stack_facts: Kotlin services on JVM, Spring Boot
MQTT over TLS for charger telemetry

attractor.name: Drivers stranded
attractor.description: Drivers cannot unlock chargers; defection to competitor; loss + reputation.
attractor.why_system_drifts_here: Single-region; chargers depend on cloud unlock commands.

residue.name: Local autonomy
residue.intent: Charger holds last-known auth + per-charger budget for N hours
residue.minimal_change_description: Cache identity tokens and a per-charger session budget locally; serve unlock from cache when cloud unreachable.
